invariants.expression: profile != null && context != null && profile.getPartitionPaths() != null && !profile.getPartitionPaths().isEmpty() && totalBuckets >= 0
invariants.rationale: At method exit, profile and context should still be non-null, partition paths set non-empty, and totalBuckets is incremented non-negatively.
partitionPathToInsertBucketInfos is populated in the method and should remain non-null.
Partitions with inserts will have insert bucket infos recorded; partitions without inserts may not.
totalBuckets tracks the number of buckets created and bucketInfoMap size is expected to be less or equal.
Every partition path should have an associated WorkloadStat.
